headline: Executive order creates a presidential advisory council to give the President advice on U.S. infrastructure.
what_it_does: This order sets up a Presidential Advisory Council on Infrastructure. Based on the title, the council's job is to advise the President on infrastructure, such as roads, bridges, and other public systems. No summary was provided, so details like who serves on the council and what it must study are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal officials working on infrastructure policy
who_it_affects.how: They may receive advice and recommendations from the new council.
They would serve as advisers to the President on infrastructure issues.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 19, 2017; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
